title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Calculation of the Hardship Discount on a Charge
content:
**Calculation schedule — financial assistance, Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility.**

**Formal clause.** The hardship discount on a charge is the account's assistance percentage of the charge's amount as posted, rounded to the cent half up. The assistance percentage is the discount percentage of the approved hardship tier, and it is capped at 100 percent.

| Approved hardship tier on the coverage record | Assistance percentage |
|---|---|
| full-100 | 100 |
| partial-75 | 75 |
| partial-50 | 50 |
| partial-25 | 25 |

## Inputs and where they are read

- **The charge.** The discount figured is the one for the account's most recently posted patient charge. It is 0.00, and nothing is posted, when that charge is of a type the discount never reaches or was posted more than the class's hardship lookback period (180 calendar days in every payer class) before the approval date.
- **The charge's amount as posted.** The amount the patient charge carried when it was posted — not what remains open on it after payments.
- **The approval.** The hardship tier and the hardship approval date on the coverage record. An approval is in force while fewer than the class's hardship approval term (12 calendar months in every payer class) whole calendar months have passed between the hardship approval date and the handling date. An account whose hardship tier is none, or whose approval is no longer in force, receives no hardship discount: the discount is 0.00.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Coverage record: hardship tier partial-50, approved 4 whole calendar months before the handling date. Most recently posted patient charge: a coinsurance charge of 84.37; the patient has since paid 20.00 against it.

1. Approval in force: 4 whole months is fewer than 12.
2. Assistance percentage: partial-50 gives 50.
3. Base: the amount as posted, 84.37 (the 20.00 payment does not change it).
4. 50 percent of 84.37 is 42.185, rounded to the cent half up: **42.19**.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Situation | Discount |
|---|---|
| Same charge, approval 11 whole months old | 42.19 |
| Same charge, approval 12 whole months old | 0.00 — the approval is no longer in force |
| Most recent charge is a self-pay charge | 0.00 — a type the discount never reaches |
| Most recent charge posted 180 days before the approval date | 42.19 |
| Most recent charge posted 181 days before the approval date | 0.00 |
| Tier full-100, charge of 61.20 | 61.20 |
